introduction_section.heading: What is a Business
content: A business AI agent is a software system that can understand a request, use connected tools, retrieve information, follow instructions, and perform useful actions inside a controlled workflow. Unlike a basic chatbot, an AI agent can work with CRMs, databases, documents, calendars, forms, APIs, and internal systems to support real business operations.

At Devisgon, we design AI agents with clear permissions, reliable integrations, human approval points, monitoring, and business specific logic. This allows your team to automate repetitive tasks, improve customer response speed, reduce manual data work, and keep control over sensitive actions.
introduction_section.highlight_quote: “AI agents turn repetitive business tasks into intelligent, connected, and controlled digital workflows.”

faq_section.title: AI Agent Questions and Answers
faq_section.subtitle: Detailed answers for founders, business leaders, and technical teams evaluating custom AI agents

questions.question: What is an AI agent and how is it different from a chatbot?
questions.answer: A chatbot mainly responds to messages, while an AI agent can perform tasks through connected tools and workflows. It can read data, call APIs, update systems, prepare outputs, and route work based on business rules. This makes it useful for operations, support, sales, and internal automation.

questions.question: What tasks can a business AI agent automate?
questions.answer: AI agents can automate lead qualification, customer support triage, CRM updates, document summaries, email preparation, task creation, research, reporting, and workflow routing. The best use cases are repetitive tasks that still require context, judgment, and structured data handling.

questions.question: Can AI agents connect with our CRM, email, and internal tools?
questions.answer: Yes. AI agents can connect with CRMs, email platforms, calendars, databases, spreadsheets, forms, documents, dashboards, APIs, and automation tools. Devisgon designs these integrations with clear permissions and validation so the agent works safely inside your existing software stack.

questions.question: Are AI agents safe for business operations?
questions.answer: AI agents are safe when they are built with permissions, audit logs, approval checkpoints, tool limits, and fallback rules. Sensitive actions should not be fully open ended. We design AI agents with controlled access so your team can benefit from automation without losing operational control.

questions.question: Can an AI agent work with human approval before taking action?
questions.answer: Yes. Human approval can be required before sending emails, changing CRM stages, deleting records, publishing content, creating invoices, or triggering critical workflows. The agent can prepare the action, explain the context, and wait for approval before execution.

questions.question: How do you prevent incorrect AI outputs?
questions.answer: We use structured prompts, trusted knowledge sources, schema validation, business rules, tool restrictions, and testing workflows. For higher risk tasks, we add review checkpoints and validation layers. This reduces unreliable outputs and keeps the agent aligned with your business process.

questions.question: How long does it take to build a custom AI agent?
questions.answer: The timeline depends on workflow complexity, number of integrations, data readiness, security requirements, and approval logic. A focused AI agent proof of concept can be faster, while production systems need discovery, mapping, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance planning.

questions.question: Does Devisgon provide maintenance after launch?
questions.answer: Yes. AI agents need ongoing monitoring, prompt improvements, integration updates, workflow refinements, testing, and performance optimization. Devisgon provides post launch support so the agent remains reliable as your tools, data, and business rules change.
